title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초1 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ Principle 09 ]

blocks.text: 1I was born in a small village by some beautiful mountains.
I have many great memories of my childhood.
I played with my friends so much that we had often lost track of the time.
There was a river near my village where my friends and I went to swim and to catch fish with our hands.
My family moved to the big city because of my father’s company and for us to receive a better education.
When I was young, my father’s company went bankrupt, so we had to move several more times.
Our family’s financial situation was not very stable, so my mother had to work, too.
I grew up well taken care of because even though my mother had to work, she still managed to take good care of me and my brothers and sisters.
When I was thirteen, my family and I moved to Seoul.
I spent all my early school life in Seoul.
I also got a job and got married in Seoul.
It is like my second hometown.
I like living in Seoul because living in the big city is very comfortable and convenient.
Sadly, however, I sometimes miss the village where I was born and spent the early part of my childhood.
